name: Hunter Neely
summary: Hunter Neely is a fitness creator referred by Samantha who reached out to get his disabled Instagram account @hunterneely_ recovered (disabled July 31, 2026 for 'account integrity' / Community Standards violations, already appealed and told he could not request another review). Derrek confirmed the recovery was doable but priced higher since Hunter had already appealed; they agreed to discuss details on a phone call. Hunter sent payment via Zelle to ALTR PLATFORM SERVICES LLC — a $500 screenshot plus a follow-up message on 2026-08-04 saying he 'sent the other 1000,' suggesting roughly $1,500 total. Follow-up: confirm full payment received and deliver the account recovery, plus he asked about clearing existing violations and preventing future ones.
